name: How do multi-family renovations differ from single-family home renovations?

mainEntity.name: How do multi-family renovations differ from single-family home renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multi-family renovations involve greater complexity due to the scale, multiple occupants, and shared infrastructure. Unlike single-family homes, multi-family projects often require managing common areas, navigating stricter building codes for fire safety and accessibility, and coordinating work across numerous units while minimizing disruption to residents. The permitting process can also be more extensive. Opus Builders understands these distinctions, applying specialized expertise to handle the unique logistical and regulatory demands of multi-family properties, ensuring efficient and compliant project execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Multi-family renovations are more complex due to scale, multiple occupants, shared infrastructure, and stricter building codes. They require specialized management of logistics and regulations compared to single-family homes.
